installSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _sync_meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, value TEXT)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _sync_meta (key, value) VALUES ('applying', '0')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _sync_outbox (table_name TEXT NOT NULL, pk_json TEXT NOT NULL, op TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('upsert', 'delete')), changed_at INTEGER NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (table_name, pk_json)) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _sync_records (record_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, table_name TEXT NOT NULL, system_fields BLOB NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TRIGGER "_sync_notes_insert" AFTER INSERT ON "notes" WHEN (SELECT value FROM _sync_meta WHERE key = 'applying') IS NOT '1' BEGIN INSERT INTO _sync_outbox (table_name, pk_json, op, changed_at) SELECT 'notes', json_array(CAST(NEW."id" AS TEXT)), 'upsert', CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) WHERE true ON CONFLICT (table_name, pk_json) DO UPDATE SET op = excluded.op, changed_at = excluded.changed_at, version = version + 1; END

CREATE TRIGGER "_sync_notes_update" AFTER UPDATE ON "notes" WHEN (SELECT value FROM _sync_meta WHERE key = 'applying') IS NOT '1' BEGIN INSERT INTO _sync_outbox (table_name, pk_json, op, changed_at) SELECT 'notes', json_array(CAST(OLD."id" AS TEXT)), 'delete', CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) WHERE OLD."id" IS NOT NEW."id" ON CONFLICT (table_name, pk_json) DO UPDATE SET op = excluded.op, changed_at = excluded.changed_at, version = version + 1; INSERT INTO _sync_outbox (table_name, pk_json, op, changed_at) SELECT 'notes', json_array(CAST(NEW."id" AS TEXT)), 'upsert', CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) WHERE true ON CONFLICT (table_name, pk_json) DO UPDATE SET op = excluded.op, changed_at = excluded.changed_at, version = version + 1; END

CREATE TRIGGER "_sync_notes_delete" AFTER DELETE ON "notes" WHEN (SELECT value FROM _sync_meta WHERE key = 'applying') IS NOT '1' BEGIN INSERT INTO _sync_outbox (table_name, pk_json, op, changed_at) SELECT 'notes', json_array(CAST(OLD."id" AS TEXT)), 'delete', CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) WHERE true ON CONFLICT (table_name, pk_json) DO UPDATE SET op = excluded.op, changed_at = excluded.changed_at, version = version + 1; END
